transformedBody.skillName: 世界の平和を取り戻す
transformedBody.description:

ダメージ吸収と属性吸収を無効化、ダメージ無効を貫通。

unspecified: which Kali casts at opening step 6

assumptions.badge: saved selection only; choose badge 89 in the native game

opening.chosenKaliReason: After step 5, slot 4 has recharged to CD3; slot 5 just reset and slot 6 must retain its charged assist for step 7.
opening.firstPuzzle: Use the board supplied in step 6; do not consume a second Kali. Other ready body rules still run.
opening.chargeModel: Uncapped static arithmetic: accepted skill resets its slot, each haste charges other slots, no enemy delay or extra skills and no elapsed puzzle turns. Native storage may cap a ready body (for example Indra at CD5); these values are scheduling evidence, not predicted native readings or a runtime simulation.
opening.manualOpeningProfile: Only after the same seven steps while the first puzzle is still pending; arbitrary mid-run entry must not reuse startAfter=1.

rotation.himmel: Three required enemy counters plus one optional ready body rule share group 2. Skill charge relies on actual five-color attacks and native cooldown; 8-turn self cap is not 8-turn bypass.
rotation.gerard: body source, exact monster 14084, skill 0 deliberately follows evolving stages 64942/64943/64944/64945; root 64941 is not the chosen stage.
rotation.indra: Optional native-ready body skill; 8-turn recovery boost, only 1-turn 80% shield and spinner. Not a continuous shield.
rotation.kali: Three required alternatives, group 1, order 5/4/6, accepted every 1, startAfter 1. One confirmed member satisfies the group; no available member stops movement.

limitations: No fixed-floor or dungeon-specific clear plan
No damage, HP survival or attack-badge effectiveness guarantee
Five-color attack/skill-charge needs actual native attacks and effective awakenings
Himmel damage/attribute absorb and void coverage lasts 3 turns; CD10 with skill charge is roughly 5 puzzle turns, leaving gaps
Indra creates a spinner instead of removing all spinners; normal full-phase planning gates remain
No poison allowance, no automatic latent assignment, no recovery-L providers assumed
Post-opening portable profile binds current body numbers only; the player must complete and confirm consumed assists and opening manually
